Days table has scattered wrong seconds and minutes (13 reads 0 11 43 57; rows 3, 4, 14, 15 and others also differ; day 31 ends 41).
The radix note reads 1472 (a year) with 1 24 23 17; the candidate garbles the year and the last figure.

English glosses and expanded terms (Signa, Gradus…) in the vocab line are not on the page.

verdict.reader_note: The layout and headings match the leaf, but the numerals are unreliable throughout: the years table has invented rows and mostly wrong values, and the months, bissextile and days tables carry many misread 4/5/7 figures.
